theorems.name: Submission.frt_vgm_tba_product_blowup_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ : ℝ), HasTangentPlane V x T θ → ∀ (g : C_c(Euclidean N, ℝ)) (β : C(Grassmannian N n, ℝ)), Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ t⁻¹ ^ n * ∫ z, g (t⁻¹ • (z.1 - x)) * β z.2 ∂V.measure) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (θ * (β T * ∫ y in (T.plane : Set (Euclidean N)), g y ∂μHE[n])))
